all_flagged: Review every candidate with any predeclared collector quality flag before supervised use; reject unresolved boundaries rather than substituting the whole report.
ordinary_sample: For each sector and filing calendar year, inspect the unflagged candidate with smallest SHA256 of text-quality-100-v1:issuer_id:accession. Include both original company roles; selection does not access market labels or predictions.
method: Agent-assisted source boundary and interior-text inspection, with explicit decisions, hashes, reasons and rejected cases. This is development QA, not independent human certification or a universal extraction-accuracy estimate.
training_gate: No supervised text fit until this QA and date/role/PCA checks finish. Unreviewed bulk candidates may be frozen-encoded but are not claimed individually validated.
alignment: Strictly after filing calendar date; most recent accepted original annual 10-K, stale after 550 calendar days. Staleness/availability/log content length remain separate controls. No later amendment or future filing is backfilled.
reduction: Up to 32 components fitted only on unique documents actually joined to training-company, training-period origins; no validation/evaluation or held-company documents.
